import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1000100;
    static final int INF_VAL = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD_VAL = 1000000007;
    static final int P_CONST = 6151;
    static final int T_CONST = 2000;
    static final int SQ_CONST = 280;
    static final int LOG_SIZE = 64;
    static final int LOG2_SIZE = 34;

    static int total_nodes, base_d;
    static List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
    static node[] node_array = new node[LOG_SIZE];
    static node[] helper = new node[LOG_SIZE];
    static node temp_node = new node();

    static class node {
        int[][] matrix = new int[LOG2_SIZE][LOG2_SIZE];
        int[][] temp = new int[LOG2_SIZE][LOG2_SIZE];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[LOG2_SIZE];
        boolean[] toggled = new boolean[LOG2_SIZE];

        void combine(node other) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= base_d; k++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] + (int)((long)matrix[k][j] * other.matrix[i][k] % MOD_VAL)) % MOD_VAL;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                if (visited[i] && !other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!visited[i] && other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[j][i] = other.matrix[j][i];
                    }
                }
                visited[i] |= other.visited[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int shift_value) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < base_d; j++) {
                    int ni = (i + shift_value) % base_d;
                    int nj = (j + shift_value) % base_d;
                    temp[ni][nj] = matrix[i][j];
                }
                temp[(i + shift_value) % base_d][base_d] = matrix[i][base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                temp[base_d][(i + shift_value) % base_d] = matrix[base_d][i];
            }
            temp[base_d][base_d] = matrix[base_d][base_d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = temp[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                toggled[i] = visited[(i + shift_value) % base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                visited[i] = toggled[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static node fetch_node(int x) {
        int h = x, power = 1, t_index = -1;
        while (h >= base_d) {
            h /= base_d;
            power *= base_d;
            t_index++;
        }
        x %= power;
        if (t_index == -1)
            return helper[h];
        node result_node = node_array[t_index];
        temp_node = node_array[t_index];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            temp_node.shift(1);
            result_node.combine(temp_node);
        }
        temp_node = node_array[t_index];
        temp_node = fetch_node(x);
        temp_node.shift(h);
        result_node.combine(temp_node);
        return result_node;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        total_nodes = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        base_d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        total_nodes--;
        int temp_n = total_nodes;
        while (total_nodes > 0) {
            digits.add(total_nodes % base_d);
            total_nodes /= base_d;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < LOG_SIZE; i++) {
            node_array[i] = new node();
            helper[i] = new node();
        }
        node_array[0].matrix[base_d][base_d] = 2;
        node_array[0].matrix[base_d][0] = -1;
        node_array[0].matrix[0][base_d] = 1;
        node_array[0].visited[0] = true;

            }

        node final_ans = fetch_node(temp_n);

    }

    static node cloneNode(node original) {
        node clone = new node();
        for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(original.matrix[i], 0, clone.matrix[i], 0, base_d + 1);
            System.arraycopy(original.temp[i], 0, clone.temp[i], 0, base_d + 1);
        }
        System.arraycopy(original.visited, 0, clone.visited, 0, base_d);
        System.arraycopy(original.toggled, 0, clone.toggled, 0, base_d);
        return clone;
    }
